 The draft of the first four couplets in Nbk 11, though it includes three rejected lines, shows
no sign of having been intended for a sonnet. Nor does the draft of ll. 9–13 in Nbk 10. BSM
xiv 306 suggests possible connections between the Nbk 11 draft and other draft material in the
same nbk. Certainly, the isolated draft phrase ‘this is the common cant/ Of those who hate’
(161) has affinities with this poem and with To —— [Lines to a Critic]. Lines to a Reviewer
would seem to have begun life as a series of couplets in the manner of A Satire upon Satire
